title: Maria Wang says her husband reported directly to Henry Kissinger

tellings.quote: She said that her husband had reported directly to Henry Kissinger.

plain: A man named Eric Wang, who worked at Wright-Patterson Air Force Base in Ohio in the 1950s, reported directly to Henry Kissinger, according to his wife, Maria Wang. Michels relays her words in an episode asking whether Kissinger oversaw a programme to recover crashed UFOs, and he cites the researcher William Steinman alongside her. If true, it would put Kissinger in the chain of command for that work.
